title: The Source for Cleansing and the Removal of Idols
description: On that day a fountain will be opened for the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to cleanse them from sin and impurity. The Lord will remove the names of idols from the land and get rid of the prophets and the unclean spirit. If anyone still prophesies, their own parents will pierce them through for speaking lies in the name of the Lord. The prophets will be ashamed of their visions; they will no longer wear a hairy cloak to deceive, but will deny that they are prophets and call themselves farmers who bear wounds from the houses of their friends.
